info.title: Flashduty Open API
info.description: Public HTTP API for the Flashduty AI SRE platform — skills, MCP servers (connectors), A2A agents, and sessions. Every operation is authenticated with an `app_key` query parameter issued from the Flashduty console.

post.description: Register a new A2A remote agent from its agent-card URL.

x-mint.content:
## Restrictions

| Aspect | Value |
| ------ | ----- |
| Rate limits | **300 requests/minute**; **20 requests/second** per account |
| Permissions | **Agent Manage** (`ai-sre`) |

## Usage

- `instructions` is required; a deprecated `description` field is still accepted for legacy clients and, if both are sent, must exactly match `instructions`.
- `card_url` must be an absolute `http`/`https` URL with a non-empty host (reachability is enforced by the execution environment, not here); `auth_type` accepts only `none`, `api_key`, or `bearer`.
- `environment_kind` accepts only empty (automatic) or `byoc`; `cloud` is rejected. `byoc` requires `environment_id`, and the runner must be visible to the caller.
- Creating into a team (`team_id > 0`) requires the caller to actually belong to that team; only the account owner/admin may create at account scope (`team_id=0`).
- Every call is recorded in the account audit log.

## Usage

- Pagination uses `offset`/`limit` (not `p`/`limit`).

- `card_resolve_timeout` and `task_timeout` are always `0` today — the API does not yet expose a way to set them.

x-mint.content:
## Restrictions

| Aspect | Value |
| ------ | ----- |
| Rate limits | **300 requests/minute**; **20 requests/second** per account |
| Permissions | **Agent Manage** (`ai-sre`) |

## Usage

- Requires edit permission (`access.CanEdit`) on the agent's *current* team before any field may change.
- Reassigning `team_id` requires rights on the destination team; if the team changes without also sending a new environment binding, the existing runner binding must remain selectable by the caller or the update is rejected.
- Changing `auth_mode` always rewrites `secret_schema` together with it; omitting `oauth_metadata` alongside a new `auth_mode` clears it to empty.
- Sending back a masked or empty value for a sensitive `auth_config` key (`api_key`, `token`, `client_secret`) keeps the stored secret instead of overwriting it.
- Every call is recorded in the account audit log.

post.description: Publish an already-presented session file to the gallery as an artifact.

x-mint.content:
## Restrictions

| Aspect | Value |
| ------ | ----- |
| Rate limits | **300 requests/minute**; **20 requests/second** per account |
| Permissions | None to publish a new artifact; overwriting an already-published file requires **artifact ownership** (creator, account admin/owner, or a member of the artifact's team) on the existing row |

## Usage

- `file_id` must reference an already-presented file (typically obtained from a chat file card); its extension must be `.html`, `.htm`, or `.md`, and its size must be ≤16 MiB.
- Publishing a not-yet-published file is account-wide — any member of the account holding the `file_id` may publish it. Overwriting an artifact already published from the same session and workspace path additionally requires ownership of the existing row (creator, account admin/owner, or a member of its team).
- `gallery_path` in the response is the console route `/ai-sre/artifacts/<artifact_id>` — not an unauthenticated public URL; viewing it still requires authentication.
- Every call is recorded in the account audit log.

post.description: Create an Automation rule with schedule, HTTP POST, and On-call incident triggers.

x-mint.content:
## Restrictions

| Aspect | Value |
| ------ | ----- |
| Rate limits | **300 requests/minute**; **20 requests/second** per account |
| Permissions | Valid `app_key`; management operations require the caller to manage the target rule |

## Usage

- A caller may create personal rules and rules for any team in the current account; `team_id` is immutable after creation.
- `cron_expr` is evaluated in `timezone` if provided, else the caller's member timezone, else the account timezone, else UTC.
- `http_post_trigger_enabled=true` creates and enables an HTTP POST trigger; the response's `http_post_token` is a one-time value returned only on creation — save it immediately.
- `oncall_incident_trigger_enabled=true` requires at least one `oncall_incident_channel_ids` entry and one `oncall_incident_severities` value; matching incidents run with `trigger_kind=oncall_incident`.
- Every call is recorded in the account audit log.

post.description: Manually run an Automation rule immediately, outside its schedule.

x-mint.content:
## Restrictions

| Aspect | Value |
| ------ | ----- |
| Rate limits | **100 requests/minute**; **5 requests/second** per account |
| Permissions | Valid `app_key`; caller must manage the target rule |

## Usage

- Rate-limited to at most once per minute per rule; a second call within that window returns `429` with `code: "RequestTooFrequently"`.
- Only enabled rules can run manually; a disabled or misconfigured rule fails preflight with a `400` error before any run is created.
- The call returns once the underlying agent session starts, not once the run finishes; the run continues asynchronously — use List Automation runs to check completion status.
- `trigger_kind` is always `manual` for runs started this way, distinguishing them from `schedule`, `http_post`, and `oncall_incident` runs in run history.
- Every call is recorded in the account audit log.

x-mint.content:
## Restrictions

| Aspect | Value |
| ------ | ----- |
| Rate limits | **300 requests/minute**; **20 requests/second** per account |
| Permissions | Valid `app_key`; caller must be an owner/admin or belong to the target team |

## Usage

- A cloud environment template carries no connection token or liveness status — unlike a self-hosted environment, it is provisioning config only (egress policy, env vars, setup script) that sandboxes are created from.
- Omitting egress fields resolves to the safe default: `egress_mode=default` with only the global default allowlist.
- `include_default_list` defaults to `true` when omitted.
- Account-scope (`team_id=0`) creation is owner/admin-only; creating into a team requires membership in that team.
- Every call is recorded in the account audit log.

- There is no `token`/`install` block in the response — cloud templates carry no connection credentials, unlike self-hosted `get`.

x-mint.content:
## Restrictions

| Aspect | Value |
| ------ | ----- |
| Rate limits | **300 requests/minute**; **20 requests/second** per account |
| Permissions | None — any valid `app_key` can call this operation |

## Usage

- Personal sessions can be deleted only by their creator; team sessions can be deleted by the creator, an account admin, or a member of the owning team.

post.description: Stream a session's full event transcript as newline-delimited JSON.

x-mint.content:
## Restrictions

| Aspect | Value |
| ------ | ----- |
| Rate limits | **20 requests/minute**; **1 requests/second** per account |
| Permissions | None — any valid `app_key` can call this operation |

## Usage

- Personal sessions are exportable only by their creator; team sessions can be exported by same-account callers with the `session_id`.
- The response is `application/x-ndjson` — parse line-by-line and write to a file; do not buffer the whole body in memory.
- The first line is always a `session_meta` envelope; `include_subagents=true` inlines each child session's stream after its dispatch line.
- Requests are capped at a 60-second execution timeout; very large sessions may not finish exporting within that window.
- If the stream fails partway through, the response ends with a JSON error line instead of a proper error envelope (headers are already sent) — check for this trailing line to detect truncation.

200.description: Streaming NDJSON (application/x-ndjson). One JSON object per line, terminated by a newline. The first line is always a `session_meta` envelope; subsequent lines are session events.

MCPServerCreateRequest.description: Configuration for a new MCP server.

server_name.description: MCP server name, unique within the account.

auth_mode.description: Authentication mode: shared (default), per_user_secret, or per_user_oauth.

secret_schema.description: JSON secret schema; required when auth_mode=per_user_secret.

oauth_metadata.description: JSON OAuth metadata; reserved for per_user_oauth.

team_id.description: Team scope: 0 = account-wide; >0 = team.

environment_kind.description: Pin the server to a specific BYOC runner (`environment_id` required). Omit or send empty for automatic selection; `cloud` is not supported for MCP servers.

environment_id.description: Runner ID; required when environment_kind is byoc.

allow_insecure_oauth_http.description: Allow this server's OAuth token exchange over plaintext HTTP. Testing use only; defaults to false.

allow_insecure_tls_skip_verify.description: Skip TLS certificate verification when connecting to this server. Testing use only; defaults to false.

source_template_name.description: Marketplace template name when created from a connector template.

MCPServerItem.description: An MCP server (connector) registered on the account.

team_id.description: Team scope: 0 = account-wide; >0 = the owning team.

can_edit.description: Whether the caller may edit this server.

environment_kind.description: Runtime environment kind: empty for automatic selection, or `byoc` when pinned to a specific runner. `cloud` cannot be bound to an MCP server.

environment_id.description: Runner ID when environment_kind is byoc; empty otherwise.

server_name.description: MCP server name, unique within the account.

ai_description.description: LLM-generated description, preferred over `description` when present.

env.description: Environment variables (stdio transport). Secret values are masked.

headers.description: HTTP headers (sse / streamable-http). Secret values are masked.

proxy_url.description: Outbound proxy URL used to reach the server.

connect_timeout.description: Connection timeout in seconds (0 = server default, 10s).

call_timeout.description: Tool-call timeout in seconds (0 = server default, 60s).

allow_insecure_oauth_http.description: Allow this server's OAuth token exchange over plaintext HTTP; testing use only.

allow_insecure_tls_skip_verify.description: Skip TLS certificate verification when connecting to this server; testing use only.

tools.description: Live tool list; populated by the get/test endpoints.

tool_count.description: Number of tools in the live list.

list_error.description: Error message when the live tool list failed.

source_template_name.description: Marketplace template this connector was installed from; empty for user-authored.

created_by.description: Member ID that created the server.

created_at.description: Creation time. Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

updated_at.description: Last update time. Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

MCPServerListRequest.description: Pagination, scope, and search filters for listing MCP servers.

scope.description: Restrict results to a scope: `account` for account-wide rows only, `team` for the caller's own visible team rows only, or omit (defaults to `all`) for both, subject to team_ids/include_account.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring search across name, description, AI-generated description, server ID, transport, URL, command, and source template name.

team_ids.description: Filter to these team IDs; empty = the caller's visible set.

include_account.description: Include account-scoped (team_id=0) rows. Defaults to true.

MCPServerUpdateRequest.description: Partial update of an MCP server. Omit a field to leave it unchanged.

auth_mode.description: Authentication mode: shared (default), per_user_secret, or per_user_oauth.

secret_schema.description: JSON secret schema; required when auth_mode=per_user_secret.

oauth_metadata.description: JSON OAuth metadata; reserved for per_user_oauth.

team_id.description: Reassign team scope: 0 = account-wide; >0 = team. Omit to leave unchanged.

environment_kind.description: Reassign the runner binding: `byoc` (with environment_id) or empty string to reset to automatic selection. Omit (null) to leave the current binding unchanged.

environment_id.description: Runner ID paired with environment_kind=byoc. Omit (null) to leave the current binding unchanged.

allow_insecure_oauth_http.description: Allow OAuth token exchange over plaintext HTTP. Omit to leave unchanged.

allow_insecure_tls_skip_verify.description: Skip TLS certificate verification. Omit to leave unchanged.

MCPToolInfo.description: Metadata for one tool exposed by an MCP server.

input_schema.description: JSON Schema describing the tool's input parameters.

ManualRunRuleResult.description: Result of manually running an Automation rule outside its schedule.

PreflightResult.description: Readiness checks computed before a manual run is allowed to start.

ok.description: Whether all readiness checks passed. Always true in a response that reaches the caller — a failed preflight returns a 400/403 error instead of a payload with ok=false.

checks.description: Names of the readiness checks performed, in order. Current fixed set: rule_loaded, actor_authorized, app_allowed, runtime_scope_resolved, rule_config_valid.

scope.description: Resolved run scope for this run; mirrors the rule's run_scope.

team_id.description: Rule's scope team ID; 0 means a personal rule.

app_name.description: App the rule is scoped to. Currently always ai-sre; manual runs are only supported for that app.

warnings.description: Non-fatal warnings surfaced during preflight. Omitted or empty when there are none.

PublishedArtifactItem.description: A published artifact — an HTML or Markdown page published from an AI SRE session file into the gallery.

team_id.description: Scope of the artifact: 0 = personal, attributed to `person_id`; >0 = the owning team.

team_name.description: Name of the owning team. Present only when `team_id` > 0.

person_id.description: Person ID of the artifact's creator.

creator_name.description: Display name of the creator, resolved best-effort; empty if it cannot be resolved.

is_mine.description: True when the caller is the creator (`person_id` matches the caller).

can_edit.description: True when the caller may rename or remove this artifact: the creator, an account admin/owner, or a member of the artifact's team.

session_id.description: ID of the AI SRE session the artifact was published from.

file_id.description: ID of the underlying presented file (t_presented_file row) backing the artifact's current content.

name.description: Filename of the underlying presented file.

size.description: Size of the underlying file, in bytes.

content_type.description: MIME content type of the underlying file.

created_at.description: Creation time. Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

updated_at.description: Last update time, including republish and rename. Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

ResponseEnvelope.description: Standard response envelope used by every Flashduty public API. On success `data` contains the endpoint-specific payload and `error` is absent. On failure `error` is present and `data` is absent. `request_id` is always present and is also mirrored in the `Flashcat-Request-Id` response header.

request_id.description: Unique ID for this request. Mirrored in the Flashcat-Request-Id header. Include it when reporting issues.

data.description: Endpoint-specific payload. See each operation's 200 response schema.

RunnerInstallInfo.description: Deployment-configured values the frontend uses to render runner install/upgrade commands.

install_script_url.description: URL of the install.sh script to curl on the target host.

connect_url.description: WebSocket URL the runner dials to connect (the install script's `URL=` value).

SessionExportRequest.description: Export the full event transcript of one session as a streaming NDJSON body.

include_subagents.description: When true, each subagent_dispatch line is followed by the child session's full event stream, bracketed by its own session_meta. Defaults to false.

SessionGetRequest.description: Fetch one session plus a backward-paged window of its most recent events.

num_recent_events.description: Legacy page size: number of most-recent events to return. Superseded by `limit` when both are set; 0 uses the server default (100).

limit.description: Page size for events; takes precedence over `num_recent_events`. 0 uses the server default (100).

search_after_ctx.description: Opaque keyset cursor from a previous response; pass it back to fetch the next older page.

SessionGetResponse.description: A session plus a backward-paged window of its events.

has_more_older.description: True when older events remain beyond this page.

search_after_ctx.description: Opaque keyset cursor; pass back as search_after_ctx to fetch the next older page. Omitted when has_more_older is false.

suggest_init.description: Account-wide onboarding flag: true when the account has zero knowledge packs in any scope; not specific to this session.

parent_session_id.description: Parent session id for subagent (child) sessions; empty otherwise.

session_name.description: Session title; may be empty for untitled sessions.

app_name.description: Agent app that owns the session.

team_id.description: Owning team id; 0 means no team is bound. Immutable after create.

team_name.description: Resolved team name; empty for unbound rows or deleted teams.

is_mine.description: True when the caller created this session.

can_manage.description: True when the caller may rename/archive/delete the session; personal sessions are creator-only, team sessions allow the creator, account admin, or team member.

created_at.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when the session was created.

updated_at.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds of the last session update.

template_staging_round_id.description: Current save→validate round id (template-assistant only); empty otherwise.

state.description: Raw session-state bag (session-scoped keys). Omitted when empty.

current_context_tokens.description: Size in tokens of the LLM context window as of the most recent turn. 0 means no turn has completed.

context_window.description: The bound model's max context size in tokens. 0 means unknown.

archived_at.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when archived; 0 means not archived.

pinned_at.description: Caller's per-user pin timestamp in milliseconds; 0 means not pinned.

last_event_at.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds of the most recent assistant-side event.

is_running.description: True when an agent turn is currently in flight for this session.

has_unread.description: True when there is assistant output the caller has not yet viewed.

current_turn_started_at.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when the current or most recent round started; 0 if no round has started yet.

current_turn_active_ms.description: Active working duration in milliseconds for the current or most recent round, excluding time spent waiting on ask_user; resets to 0 at the start of each new round.

current_turn_wait_ms.description: Accumulated ask_user human-wait duration in milliseconds for the current round; resets to 0 at the start of each new round.

current_turn_tokens.description: Total tokens (input+output+reasoning) for the in-flight round across the parent and its subagents; only computed by session/get while the session is running, always 0 in session/list responses and when idle.

SessionListRequest.description: Filters for listing agent sessions. `all` visibility means the caller's own personal sessions plus accessible team sessions; account admins do not see other users' personal sessions.

app_name.description: Agent app whose sessions to list.

asc.description: Ascending order when true; applies only when `orderby` is set.

include_subagent_sessions.description: Include subagent-dispatched sessions in the list.

scope.description: Visibility scope: `all` (own personal + accessible team sessions), `personal`, or `team`; default `all`.

team_ids.description: Optional explicit team filter; intersects with `scope` and never expands access.

entry_kinds.description: Restrict to sessions produced by these surfaces; empty returns every kind.

status.description: Archive bucket: active (default) returns un-archived, archived returns archived, all returns both.

total.description: Total number of sessions matching the filter (ignoring pagination).

suggest_init.description: Account-wide onboarding flag: true when the account has zero knowledge packs in any scope; not dependent on this call's filters.

SessionTokenUsage.description: Cumulative session-level token rollup across all turns. The account-billing source of truth.

input_tokens.description: Total prompt (input) tokens, including the cached portion.

cached_tokens.description: Portion of input_tokens served from the prompt cache.

SkillItem.description: An AI SRE skill — a packaged SKILL.md bundle the agent can load.

team_id.description: Team scope: 0 = account-wide; >0 = the owning team.

skill_name.description: Skill name, unique within the account.

description.description: Human-readable description from the SKILL.md frontmatter.

description_en.description: Optional English description. English-locale UI responses prefer this over `description`; the skill catalog also uses it as a stable selection signal when `description` is localized for display.

content.description: Full SKILL.md content. Omitted in list responses.

s3_key.description: Object-storage key of the skill zip.

checksum.description: SHA-256 checksum of the skill zip.

status.description: Skill status. Deleted skills are excluded from every API response, so only these two values are ever returned.

created_by.description: Member ID that created the skill.

created_at.description: Creation time. Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

updated_at.description: Last update time. Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

can_edit.description: Whether the caller may edit this skill.

source_template_name.description: Marketplace template this skill was installed from; empty for user-authored.

update_available.description: True when the marketplace has a newer template version.

is_modified.description: True when a marketplace-sourced skill was edited locally (auto-update skips it).

created.description: Set only on install-from-session responses: true = fresh install, false = in-place update.

SkillListRequest.description: Pagination, search, and team filter for listing skills.

scope.description: Restrict results to `all` (default), `account`-only (team_id=0), or `team`-only (excludes account-scoped rows). Overrides `include_account` when set.

query.description: Free-text search across skill name, description, English description, skill ID, marketplace source template name, and author.

team_ids.description: Filter to these team IDs; empty = the caller's visible set.

include_account.description: Include account-scoped (team_id=0) rows. Defaults to true. Ignored when `scope` is `account` or `team`.

description.description: New description. Cannot contain `<` or `>`. Sending an empty string leaves the current value unchanged — there is no way to clear it via this field.

description_en.description: New English description. Cannot contain `<` or `>`. Omit to leave unchanged; send an empty string to explicitly clear it.

team_id.description: Reassign team scope: 0 = account-wide; >0 = team. Omit to leave unchanged.

SkillUploadRequest.description: Multipart form for uploading a skill archive.

file.description: Skill archive (.skill / .zip / .tar.gz / .tgz). Max 100MB; oversized files are rejected before the body is read.

team_id.description: Team scope for the created/upserted skill: 0 = account-wide. Ignored when replacing a specific skill via `skill_id`.

replace.description: When true, overwrite an existing skill instead of failing on a name collision — matched by `skill_id` if provided, otherwise by skill name.

skill_id.description: Existing skill ID to target when replacing a specific skill (requires `replace=true`).
